about.title: About me
about.presentation:
Hey, I'm Darsh, a CSE student at VIT Chennai working around AI, ML, robotics, IoT, and web development.

I enjoy turning ideas into working projects, whether that means writing code, building hardware prototypes, experimenting at hackathons, or shaping research into something useful.

This is my archive: projects, research work, certifications, communities, mentors, and a few things still under construction.
